definitions.full: H4530. missah or missath מִסַּת noun sufficiency (derivation obscure: Aramaic מִיסַּת , , common in ᵑ6 ᵑ7 , both absolute and construct in sense of sufficiency, enough ; e.g. for Hebrew רַב 2Sam 24:16 דַּי ᵑ7, Exod 36:7 ᵑ6 ᵑ7 , Obadiah 5 ᵑ6 ᵑ7 , for לְפִי 12:4 ᵑ7 ; the amount of the debt, PS 2183 ); — Deut 16:10 and thou shalt keep the pilgrimage of weeks יָָֽדְךָ נִדְבַת מִסַּת according to (adverb accusative) the sufficiency of the free-will offering of thy hand, which thou shalt give, i.e. with the full amount that thou canst afford (compare שֶׂשׁה דֵּי Lev 5:7 ; 12:8 ; אִימְּרָא כְּמִיסַּת ᵑ7 ). מִסְתָּר מַסְתֵּר, מִסְתּוֺר, see סתר . [ מַעְבָּד ] see עבד . [ מַעֲבֶה ] see עבה . [ מַעֲבָר ], מַעְבָּרָה see עבר . מַעְגָּ֫לָה מַעְגָּל, see עגל .
